scope: Remote Web IDE stability and duplicated carried stage checkpoints
evidence: Correct-CA remote TLS root returned HTTP 200; another connection timed out in TLS.
Concurrent local-listener/remote probes both paused for seconds; Gateway CPU was 95.6 percent and native sampling showed synchronous UTF-8 file writes.
Read-only state copy contained 5164 exact duplicate stage records; no input or task was replayed for diagnosis.
Before deployment isolated Chrome eventually reached the actual odps_src_-_1 editor; the fault is intermittent latency/relay churn, not permanent certificate rejection.

layers.architecture: Delivery records retain synchronous atomic persistence and old schema; no native task ownership, certificate or authorization changes.
layers.modules: Hub owns final receipts; current presentation owns carried stages. Remote ingress owns SSH relay health independently of IDE and agent tasks.
layers.functions: Exact-content comparison; alias-safe replacement; migration, archive and late receipt handling. Three consecutive failed probes rebuild, success resets and clears stale error; owner exit/shutdown retained.
layers.static: Module and requirement docs updated; deployment config and browser script unchanged; current fixed project URL retained.

limits: Only this fault path was reviewed at four layers; full suite is not a whole-repository semantic audit.
Health failure injection uses controlled IO; post-deployment real-project browser checks are separate runtime evidence.
Historical distinct failed deliveries remain stored; no pending answer is discarded for performance.
